jobs.title: Director, Water Quality & Environmental Compliance
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Director, Water Quality & Environmental Compliance

Posting Start Date: 7/31/26

Job Description:

Position Information:

$141,390 - $225,350

The base salary range represents a good faith salary range for this position. This position is eligible for annual incentive pay and has the opportunity for continued salary growth. If you are hired at American Water your base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as market, geography, skills, education and/or experience. At American Water, we are committed to pay equity.

In addition to compensation, you will be offered a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k),Defined Contribution Plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, medical, prescription, dental and vision coverage, plus disability, paid time off, life insurance, voluntary benefits, health and wellness programs and much more!

American Water is also proud to offer employees learning opportunities and work experiences to grow professional.

Primary Role

This position is ultimately accountable and responsible for the comprehensive direction and administration of matters dealing with the overall management of laboratories, water quality, environmental stewardship and environmental rules and regulations, including those associated with the Safe Drinking Water Act & Clean Water Act. Makes decisions and recommendations that are recognized as authoritative and have far-reaching impact on environmental activities. Initiates and maintains extensive contacts with key officials and company personnel.

Executes departmental business plans and contributes to the development of functional strategies. Provides feedback to Executive Management for applicable policies and regulations.

Key Accountabilities

Develops State Water Quality and Environmental monitoring program that ensures Company compliance with regulatory and corporate standards and adherence to measurement and reporting schedules. Develops Environmental Management Plans. Continually reviews developing water quality and environmental regulations, provides input to the local, state and federal regulatory process and ensures that programs are in place to enable compliance and customer satisfaction. Tracks permits related to operation of the business.
Oversees and directs work of staff and advises other company employees regarding state operations with potential to impact water quality, public health or environmental compliance. Establishes, reviews, approves State water quality related reports and communications, coordination of Consumer Confidence Reports, and water quality operational procedures.
Interfaces with Corporate Operations Excellence on reporting and coordination of the environmental function. Provides input to Local, State and System management on water quality, public health and environmental matters.
Provides technical assistance to the state functional units on Water Quality and Environmental issues. Directs the laboratories and other water quality and environmental monitoring and control programs.
Provide technical advice and assistance with business development opportunities. Investigates new acquisitions and integrates into operations. Serves as an expert witness in legal/ratemaking proceedings.
Identifies and develops opportunities to enhance the Company’s brand through the development of innovative and sustainable environmental solutions. Identifies and develops reference projects for social responsibly, stewardship and related natural resource programs. Responsible for career development of staff. Develops O&M budget and operates to stay within the budget.
Oversees and directs company programs to address security of sources, facilities and customers against water quality and other environmental threats. Assist with the development of cross-connection and backflow prevention programs.

Knowledge/Skills

Knowledge of water/wastewater operations and water quality monitoring and quality assurance programs. Knowledge of government regulations related to water quality and employee/community safety.
Knowledge of current and emerging environmental issues.
Knowledge of environmental regulations impacting water resources and facility operations.
Knowledge of industry trade organizations to include participation in related activities aimed at improving water quality.
Knowledge of company goals and objectives. Advanced knowledge to lead and motivate subordinate staff.

Experience/Education

Bachelor’s Degree with major in Biology, Chemistry, Life Sciences, Environmental Science or equivalent is required. Master’s degree preferred.
Must have a valid driver's license.
A minimum of ten (10) years experience in environmental management of water resources and/or treatment or related technology or process development.
Experience in the management of people and budgets; development of plans and strategies. Advanced degrees could be considered as a substitution for a portion of experience.
Previous experience managing a team is required

Travel Requirements

Travel may be 25% or more
Must be able to cover a large geographical area of responsibility.
This position is eligible to sit at any of the CA American Water offices except for San Diego.
Position will be onsite, 5 days in office

Competencies

Builds Effective Teams & Network

Drives Safety Culture

Drives Vision & Purpose

Persuades

Political & Organizational Savvy

Situational Adaptability

Strategic & Learning Agility

jobs.title: Senior Remediation Subject Matter Expert (SME)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM is seeking a highly experienced Senior Remediation Subject Matter Expert (SME)
to provide technical leadership and strategic guidance for complex environmental remediation projects supporting clients in the oil & gas, refining, petrochemical, energy, and industrial sectors. This is a part-time position designed for a recognized industry expert who will serve as a senior technical resource across multiple projects, supporting project delivery, mentoring technical staff, and helping clients develop innovative, cost-effective remediation solutions.

The successful candidate will possess extensive experience with contaminated site investigation and remediation, regulatory compliance, remedial design, and closure strategies. This individual will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams while serving as a trusted advisor to clients and project managers.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

Serve as the senior technical lead and subject matter expert for environmental remediation projects involving soil, groundwater, sediment, and vapor impacts.
Provide technical oversight and quality reviews for remedial investigations, feasibility studies, corrective action plans, remedial designs, risk assessments, remedial action implementation, and site closure documentation.
Develop and review conceptual site models (CSMs), evaluate contaminant fate and transport, and recommend practical, technically sound remediation strategies.
Provide technical expertise in the evaluation, selection, and optimization of remediation technologies, including:
In-situ Chemical Oxidation (ISCO)
Soil Vapor Extraction (SVE)
Air Sparging
Multi-Phase Extraction (MPE)
Bioremediation
Pump and Treat Systems
Monitored Natural Attenuation (MNA)
Engineered containment systems
Provide strategic guidance for projects regulated under RCRA Corrective Action, CERCLA/Superfund, Brownfields, UST/LUST, and state voluntary cleanup programs.
Serve as a senior technical advisor during client meetings, regulatory discussions, and project planning activities.
Mentor and provide technical leadership to project managers, engineers, geologists, hydrogeologists, and environmental scientists.
Support business development efforts by contributing to technical proposals, scope development, project planning, and client presentations.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering and environmental teams to deliver innovative, practical, and cost-effective solutions.
Perform senior-level technical reviews to ensure quality, consistency, regulatory compliance, and adherence to AECOM quality standards.
Apply strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical writing skills while managing multiple priorities and supporting diverse project teams.
Demonstrated experience managing and providing technical oversight for complex remediation projects supporting oil & gas, refinery, petrochemical, industrial, manufacturing, or energy clients.
Extensive knowledge of federal and state environmental regulations, including RCRA, CERCLA, UST/LUST programs, and Risk-Based Corrective Action (RBCA).
Demonstrated expertise in contaminated site investigation, remedial design, remedy optimization, and regulatory closure.
Excellent technical writing, report review, presentation, and client communication skills.
Proven ability to mentor technical staff and provide leadership across multidisciplinary project teams.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geological Engineering, Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science, or a related field.
10+ years of experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications

20+ years of progressively responsible environmental consulting experience with significant remediation expertise.
Professional Engineer (PE) and/or Professional Geologist (PG) registration.
Master's degree in Engineering, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science, Geology, or a related discipline.
Experience supporting refinery, terminal, pipeline, and upstream or downstream oil & gas remediation projects.
Experience with groundwater modeling, contaminant transport modeling, and remedial system optimization.
Recognized technical expert with an established reputation within the environmental consulting industry.
Strong client relationship management and business development experience, including proposal preparation and strategic client support.

Additional Information

This position does not provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Employment is contingent upon successfully passing a pre-employment drug screen.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $60 to $85.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
